title: CAD-DRAW-MAX — autonomous propose→execute→publish loop on hyperCAD-S (draw any part + reverse engineer)
description: Closes the autonomous CAD drawing capability loop on hyperCAD-S (OPEN MIND's CAD system, sibling to hyperMILL): per-op live mutate via Live Drawing Bridge, outcome publishing, regen-test feedback adapter, neural feature/op/arg/tolerance/sequence encoder stack, tutorial-corpus ingester for offline training, orchestrator that ties them all into an end-to-end `cad_draw_any_part` action. Result: PRISM can propose CAD operations, execute them against a real or mocked hyperCAD-S session, observe regen test outcomes, learn from the result. All 10 engines shipped 2026-05-21 (slot:delta) with 61/61 vitest tests passing across the 3 capstone engines (CADDrawAnyPartOrchestrator + CADReverseTemplate + CADReverseCorpusCatalog). Dispatcher wiring complete in cadDispatcher.ts (cad_hypercads_plan_execution, cad_hypercads_outcome_adapter, cad_regen_feedback_publish, cad_draw_any_part, cad_hypercads_tutorial_ingest). Envelope created 2026-05-23 slot:delta as part of silent-close-out-debt detection (no envelope existed despite full ship — invisible to MILESTONE_PROGRESS audit).
goals: Per-operation live mutate against hyperCAD-S via HyperCADSLiveBridgeEngine (sketch/extrude/revolve/fillet/chamfer/pattern/combine/shell/export/geometry/undo/new_doc)
Outcome publishing with adapterId cad_hypercads_outcome_adapter so cross-process learning can subscribe
Regen-test feedback loop coupling op outcome to subsequent op proposals
Neural encoder stack (CADArgEncoder + CADSequencePool + CADOperationDecoder + CADUnifiedFeatureBridge + CADToleranceSignalEncoder) for learned proposal scoring
Tutorial corpus ingester to bootstrap training from documentation/example sessions
End-to-end cad_draw_any_part dispatcher action: propose → execute → publish, gated by regen test pass
